verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents an API endpoint (Create Adjustment Journal Entry) that an agent could use to post journal entries, and accountants can be granted access to update journal entries. There is no evidence of a draft or pending state, or of a review or approval queue for API-posted entries, so only the posting half of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: draft/unposted journal entry status, a review/approval queue for accountant sign-off, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven journal posting.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant

citations.quote: New entries must include the account_uuid, and the debit or credit amounts
Your accountant will be able to update your journal entries and chart of accounts
